name: ZSWEEP
aliases: ZSWEEP — An A-Buffer technique by Farias et al. that optimizes for sorting and memory usage
definition: An A-Buffer technique by Farias et al. that optimizes for sorting and memory usage.
summary: ZSWEEP is an exact, software-based volume rendering algorithm for unstructured grids that sweeps a plane through data to sort and render cells, offering superior speed and memory efficiency compared to ray-casting.
